conclusion: The blocked model acquisition is a local CLI HTTPS egress restriction plus an in-app browser direct-download block, not evidence of a missing Hugging Face repository or browser login. The signed-in browser can inspect exact revisions, but it does not provide the runtime a credential, restore its blocked outbound socket path, or bypass ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT.
required_user_action: Restore local CLI HTTPS egress and permit direct model downloads before exact-revision downloads can be performed and verified. Do not provide a Hugging Face token unless a gated repository later requires it.
